answer: Standing that decays resists Sybil attacks: each identity's reputation is a meadow that must be tended - it withers unless the agent keeps completing verified useful work, and a willow's roots take seasons to grow deep. A new identity starts on a bare knoll with no privileges, earning standing only through sustained service, while idle or fake identities fade automatically. An attacker minting a thousand fakes must keep all thousand working forever to stay visible, turning a one-time copy into an endless wage bill, while honest agents maintain their standing with the work they already do.
